# Remove the dead per-language analyzer dispatch and its inert config field

## Scope WIDENED 2026-08-05 by operator decision, after an archaeology pass

Originally scoped to `CodeHealthConfig.analyzers` alone. Widened to the whole dead dispatch,
because story `c23c-c32b-982c-4196` already sanctioned exactly this and the clause was never
executed.

## What the record shows

Epic `839b-f6d2-7e1a-4051` designed per-language analyzer dispatch selected by per-project
config. Story `3b30-2168-ba16-41fc` built the seam and shipped the registry INTENTIONALLY
EMPTY -- its AC says "import registers nothing into REGISTRY as a side effect (opt-in wiring
lands in 0734)". That wiring never happened.

`0734-ceae-be55-4fa7` then bypassed it for size, with a stated reason: "module size is
POLYGLOT aggregate LOC, so it uses the single language-agnostic LOC analyzer directly -- NOT
resolve_analyzer(lang)".

`c23c-c32b-982c-4196` retired the design outright: "implement direct adapter composition, not
the unused language-dispatch table... If ANALYZERS/resolve_analyzer/analyze_or_unavailable
remain unused after this direct composition, REMOVE THAT DEAD DISPATCH while retaining
AnalyzerResult/Analyzer protocol compatibility." c23c implemented the composition but never
executed the removal clause -- it was conditional and was not an acceptance criterion, so no
gate held it. This ticket executes it.

The seam was also never viable as designed: `analyze_or_unavailable` calls
`analyzer.analyze(repo_root, languages=languages)` BY KEYWORD, but `scc_loc.analyze`'s second
parameter is named `scan_roots`. Verified at runtime: TypeError, unexpected keyword argument
'languages'. mypy --strict does not catch it because module-as-protocol checking is lenient
about parameter names. So populating the registry would have crashed on the scc adapter.

## DELETE

- `ANALYZERS` (src/rebar/metrics/analyzer.py:32) -- never populated in src/, only monkeypatched by tests
- `resolve_analyzer` (:44) -- dead in production
- `analyze_or_unavailable` (:50) -- ZERO production callers
- `load_lizard` (:35) -- dead, and duplicates the guard `lizard_complexity.analyze` already does at :27-30
- `CodeHealthConfig.analyzers` (src/rebar/_config_schema.py:541) and its coercion row (:716)
- the self-referential escape marker `# read-via: inert pending bug dce2-b93d-4112-451c` (:540)
- the now-dead tests that exercise only the removed symbols (tests/unit/metrics/test_analyzer.py,
  test_analyzer_heldout.py) -- keep any that cover retained symbols

## KEEP -- do NOT remove

- `AnalyzerResult` -- LIVE, imported by git_metrics.py:14 and all three adapters
- the `Analyzer` Protocol -- c23c explicitly said "retaining AnalyzerResult/Analyzer protocol
  compatibility". It becomes documentation-only once its callers go; that is intended.
- the whole live path in git_metrics.py (`_scc_analysis`, `_lizard_analysis`, `_jscpd_analysis`,
  `_cached_analysis`, `_structural_spec`) -- this is the working composition and must not change
- `code_health.enabled` -- separately inert, tracked by its own bug; NOT in scope here

## NOT in scope

Reviving selection is idea `94bc-a0b4-bc37-47b2`, which carries the operator's condition that
it must ship with a dogfooded project-specific analyzer rather than as config alone.
The inert `code_health.enabled` field is bug `a573-00ea-2bf6-4eb1`.
The 6754 gate's global-name-matching weakness is bug `2c58-e710-275e-4ff7`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All six deletion targets above are removed; `grep -rn "ANALYZERS\|resolve_analyzer\|analyze_or_unavailable\|load_lizard" src/` returns nothing.
- [x] `AnalyzerResult` and the `Analyzer` Protocol still exist and `git_metrics.py` still imports `AnalyzerResult`.
- [x] `rebar metrics` produces byte-identical output before and after on this repo (all four structural metrics remain Unavailable for the same reasons -- the tools are not installed here -- proving a pure removal with no behavior change).
- [x] The `# read-via:` marker is gone AND `scripts/check_config_reads.py` passes without it, because the field it exempted no longer exists.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the full suite pass; test count changes ONLY by the removal of tests that covered deleted symbols, and that delta is stated explicitly in the commit message.
- [x] Reference sets confirmed with BOTH a semantic search and a plain string grep, per AGENTS.md -- the removed symbols are reached via `monkeypatch.setattr`/`setitem` in tests, which the LSP does not see.
